items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: That must be Eddie, I think, huh? He got a sister there across the street, but he lived down on Denver Street somewhere.

ctx.x: Well, he wouldn't get no, he looked like a white man. He wouldn't get nobody with Willie. Come to my house two o'clock in the morning. That must be Eddie, I think, huh? He got a sister there across the street, but he lived down on Denver Street somewhere.
He's a bass player, too, isn't he?
